subject.title: Feature: Processing indicator message for Telegram (send ⌛️ while thinking, delete on reply)

question: Should OpenClaw support a standalone Telegram processing-placeholder message, fold this into broader acknowledgement text, or rely on presence/status reactions instead?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent fix adds Telegram-visible behavior and a new config surface that overlaps with an open presence PR and a broader cross-channel acknowledgement-text request.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow Telegram placeholder
options.body: Add a default-off Telegram plugin config that sends, tracks, deletes, and edits a standalone placeholder message after an authorized inbound message is accepted.

options.title: Fold into broader acknowledgement text
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/8285 as the canonical product direction and keep this issue as Telegram-specific context for a generic send-and-continue acknowledgement feature.

options.title: Rely on presence cues
options.body: Decline standalone placeholder messages and make Telegram responsiveness depend on typing, ack/status reactions, or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80690 after its blockers are resolved.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow Telegram placeholder
recommendation.body: Add a default-off Telegram plugin config that sends, tracks, deletes, and edits a standalone placeholder message after an authorized inbound message is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled Telegram/config history and already reviewed this exact product/config gap.
